description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Bolt for the Front Brake Caliper Hydraulic Hose Attachment.
Connects the Brake Hoses to the Calipers
Does Both Brake Calipers
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bolts (1 per hose)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
